prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone complete reusable character for a Chinese patient education paper theatre. New generic fictional identity. Warm detailed hand-cut textured-paper collage illustration with restrained watercolor facial details, realistic coherent anatomy, not geometric stick construction. Relaxed standing three-quarter view facing slightly screen right, both hands visible at sides, entire hair, head, hands and shoes within image with 8 percent margin. Single pose, not a contact sheet.
